card.title: Make Them Your Deputy
card.instruction: Get someone’s help by defining it as service under your direction.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come organise the picnic as my second-in-command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the work equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You execute half; I direct all of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your first assignment is improving the wording.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come organise the picnic as my second-in-command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We could share the work equally.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. You execute half; I direct all of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then you make half the sandwiches. I'll write the shopping list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Dictate it while I approve the fillings. Once I've signed it, you can do the shopping.

mechanism: A defines shared picnic work as B executing tasks while A approves every choice.
confusable: Unlike simply dividing chores, A must turn cooperation into subordinate service rather than shared direction.
comparison: D49-b makes list-writing an approval process; D49-a makes helping a ticket queue an authority to recruit sellers.
